tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Composer, notes panel, cards, link previews. Also the text colour on ink.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: The well the video frame sits in on the editor. Never behind text smaller than 15px.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards, chips and the composer. Decorative: a chip's label carries the control, so the border may sit under 3:1.

tokens.name: beat
tokens.usage: Beats in the beat strip that are not playing.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, primary buttons, the user's chat bubble, the playing beat. 17.9:1 on ground.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text and chip labels. 7.7:1 on ground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta text: dates, counts, the second half of a timecode. 5.9:1 on ground, 6.4:1 on card.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: The cut and nothing else: the playhead, the mark's dashed bar, the assistant avatar, the composer glow. Never text, never a button fill.

tokens.name: coral-glow
tokens.usage: The soft ring around the composer.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One question per screen, at most. Start uses it; most screens do not need one.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the mark. Always lower case.

styles.name: reply
styles.sample: Got it. It opens fast and keeps two words of caption on screen at a time.
styles.usage: What the assistant says in a thread.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Project titles and the top of a panel.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Keep the calendar shot in colour.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, counts, captions under thumbnails. Set in muted.

styles.name: command
styles.usage: Preset commands, timecode and file names. Nothing else is mono.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside tight groups: a label and its count.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips and between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a thumbnail and its caption, list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between panels, inside small cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, the gap between a reply and its buttons.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side margins.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Breathing room above the main question or a thread.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The assistant avatar and other small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-thumb
tokens.usage: Video thumbnails and the link preview.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the notes panel, the beat strip.

tokens.name: radius-composer
tokens.usage: The composer and the preview well.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button and chip.

tokens.name: shadow-composer
tokens.usage: The composer only. It is the one thing on the page that should feel lifted.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: The video frame inside the preview well.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: The selected segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and focus: colour, border, the glow, a button pressing in.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Small things appearing or going: the slash menu, a toast or a note leaving, the old screen fading.

tokens.name: duration-gentle
tokens.usage: Things arriving: a message, a reply's parts, a note, list items, a toast. A progress bar easing to its next value.

tokens.name: duration-calm
tokens.usage: Moving between places: a screen change, the rail, a shared element, a new version crossfading, and the spring.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Something moving from one place on screen to another: the rail, the composer between screens, footage growing into the preview, a progress bar.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Arriving: quick at first, then settling. The next screen, messages, menus, toasts, list items.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Leaving: starts softly and speeds away. Always shorter than the arrival it answers.

tokens.name: spring-gentle
tokens.usage: Things a hand moves: a switch, the pill of a segmented control. Runs over duration-calm, overshoots by 4% and settles.
